WITH fb AS (
    SELECT provider_adjustment_id, payer_key, reference_id, payment_date,
           provider_adjustment_amount AS amount
    FROM sem.provider_adjustments
    WHERE plb_reason_code = 'FB'
)
SELECT n.reference_id,
       n.payment_date AS carried_forward_date,
       round(abs(n.amount), 2) AS amount_carried_forward,
       o.payment_date AS offset_date,
       date_diff('day', n.payment_date, o.payment_date) AS days_between
FROM fb n
LEFT JOIN fb o
  ON o.payer_key = n.payer_key
 AND o.reference_id = n.reference_id
 AND o.payment_date > n.payment_date
 AND abs(o.amount + n.amount) < 0.005
WHERE n.amount < 0
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY n.provider_adjustment_id
    ORDER BY o.payment_date NULLS LAST
) = 1
ORDER BY n.payment_date, n.reference_id

WITH paid AS (

    GROUP BY payer_class, payment_month

       round(100 * august_share, 1) AS august_share_pct,

ORDER BY payer_class

results.answer: Assumption: Only frequency-7 pairs with a recorded denial dated before the replacement are classified. Outcomes with no claims are omitted. Paid is 0 when there is no current adjudication. Few-shot neighbors outside this dev set: a_88c4640755 (0.3848), a_54dd76175a (0.3711), q16_denied_charges_by_payer (0.354). Candidates: 3/3 candidates agree. Result: {"columns": ["outcome", "claims", "current_paid"], "rows": [["no remit since correction", 1, 0.0]]}
results.final_sql:
WITH repl AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS replacement_date
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE frequency_code = '7'
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
),
prior_denial AS (
    SELECT r.claim_key, r.payer_key, r.replacement_date
    FROM repl r
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims d
        WHERE d.claim_key = r.claim_key AND d.payer_key = r.payer_key
          AND d.is_denied_recorded
          AND d.payment_date < r.replacement_date
    )
),
cur AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, is_denied, paid_amount
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    WHERE is_current_adjudication
),
classified AS (
    SELECT p.claim_key, p.payer_key,
           CASE
               WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims m
                   WHERE m.claim_key = p.claim_key AND m.payer_key = p.payer_key
                     AND m.payment_date >= p.replacement_date
               ) THEN 'no remit since correction'
               WHEN c.is_denied IS NOT NULL AND NOT c.is_denied THEN 'overturned'
               ELSE 'denied again'
           END AS outcome,
           coalesce(c.paid_amount, 0) AS current_paid
    FROM prior_denial p
    LEFT JOIN cur c ON c.claim_key = p.claim_key AND c.payer_key = p.payer_key
)
SELECT outcome,
       count(*) AS claims,
       round(sum(current_paid), 2) AS current_paid
FROM classified
GROUP BY outcome
ORDER BY outcome

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT claim_key, frequency_code, charge_amount
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE is_latest_submission
),
primary_first AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS first_submission
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
    GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
),
open_ar AS (
    SELECT l.claim_key, l.charge_amount,
           date_diff('day', p.first_submission, DATE '2026-08-14') AS age_days
    FROM latest l
    JOIN primary_first p ON p.claim_key = l.claim_key
    WHERE l.frequency_code <> '8'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r
          WHERE r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key
            AND r.is_current_adjudication
      )
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT CASE
               WHEN age_days <= 14 THEN '0-14'
               WHEN age_days <= 29 THEN '15-29'
               ELSE '30+'
           END AS bucket,
           charge_amount
    FROM open_ar
),
buckets AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('0-14'), ('15-29'), ('30+')) v(bucket)
)
SELECT b.bucket,
       count(u.charge_amount) AS claims,
       round(coalesce(sum(u.charge_amount), 0), 2) AS billed_charge
FROM buckets b
LEFT JOIN bucketed u ON u.bucket = b.bucket
GROUP BY b.bucket
ORDER BY CASE b.bucket WHEN '0-14' THEN 1 WHEN '15-29' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

WITH lines AS (

    FROM sem.remit_lines

    FROM lines
    GROUP BY payer_key, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount
),
typical AS (
    SELECT payer_key, procedure_code, allowed AS typical_allowed
    FROM freq
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY payer_key, procedure_code
        ORDER BY n DESC, allowed DESC
    ) = 1
),
short AS (
    SELECT l.payer_name,
           l.line_allowed_amount < t.typical_allowed AS under,
           t.typical_allowed - l.line_allowed_amount AS gap
    FROM lines l
    JOIN typical t ON t.payer_key = l.payer_key AND t.procedure_code = l.procedure_code
)
SELECT payer_name,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE under) AS underpaid_lines,
       round(coalesce(sum(gap) FILTER (WHERE under), 0), 2) AS shortfall
FROM short
GROUP BY payer_name
ORDER BY shortfall DESC, payer_name

WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT payer_class,
           strftime(payment_month, '%Y-%m') AS payment_month,
           payment_month AS month_date,
           count(*) AS current_adjudications,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied
    FROM sem.remit_claims
    WHERE is_current_adjudication
    GROUP BY payer_class, payment_month
),
rated AS (
    SELECT payer_class, payment_month, month_date, current_adjudications, denied,
           denied * 1.0 / current_adjudications AS rate
    FROM monthly
)
SELECT payer_class,
       payment_month,
       current_adjudications,
       denied,
       round(100 * rate, 2) AS denial_rate_pct,
       round(100 * (rate - lag(rate) OVER (PARTITION BY payer_class ORDER BY month_date)), 2) AS mom_change_pp
FROM rated
ORDER BY payer_class, month_date

WITH primary_sub AS (
    SELECT claim_key, payer_key, referring_npi
    FROM sem.claims
    WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY claim_key, payer_key ORDER BY submission_date DESC
    ) = 1
)
SELECT s.referring_npi,
       avg(r.is_denied::INT) AS denial_rate,
       count(*) AS claims
FROM sem.remit_claims r
JOIN primary_sub s ON s.claim_key = r.claim_key AND s.payer_key = r.payer_key
WHERE r.is_current_adjudication
GROUP BY s.referring_npi
HAVING count(*) >= 15
ORDER BY denial_rate DESC, s.referring_npi
LIMIT 5
